notes: I2 basis: the measured H2 sorbents are Cu-BTC (HKUST-1, a MOF; MOFs are not carbon sorbents under protocol 3) and Cu-BTC/GO composites whose majority component is the MOF: 'The added GO consisted of 3, 9 and 15 wt% of the material weight' (main, p. 2, Materials). Fig. 7 caption: 'H2 adsorption isotherms of Cu-BTC, CG-3, CG-9 and CG-15 at 77 K and 42 atm' (main, p. 5); the figure legend (page image checked) shows only these four samples.
